Dana, I couldn't find a settled seat count for the 2026 renewal in the records I can see, so I wouldn't put one in the tracker yet.

- The signed 2026 renewal order form (executed 2026-03-20, term 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31) doesn't state a seat count.
- The Quarrendon account page (updated 2026-09-30) lists 185 active seats and says Amendment No. 3 takes seats to 230 on 2027-01-01. I haven't read the amendment itself, so I can't confirm that figure.
- Ilse posted 261 in this channel earlier today, but nothing I found supports that number.

Ilse or June could confirm the settled figure, and June would have the amendment. I can ask June if you'd like.
